items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: And Gertrude Stein and Alice B. Toklas were there, and they would say, 'How do you find time to do all this?'

ctx.x: So we -- I mean it was so wonderful, when we came to Paris we played at the Madeleine Theater, and there was a General Biddle who was chief of the Parisian area, who really hung down from the balcony and said, 'Great. Great, Sergeant. Wonderful work.' And Gertrude Stein and Alice B. Toklas were there, and they would say, 'How do you find time to do all this?' You know.
